name: @red-cup-engineering/capability-cell-fabrication-run-monitor-service
description: Validates and folds one append-only Capability Cell fabrication event trajectory into its current observable state.

scripts.check: node --check src/schemas.mjs && node --check src/law.mjs && node --check src/observe.mjs && node --check bin/observe.mjs

x-agentic-metro-enterprise.admission: one ordered append-only fabrication event trajectory and its declared stage order
x-agentic-metro-enterprise.refusal: broken event identity, sequence, predecessor, run identity, unknown stage, or any request to analyze, plan, execute, or mutate
